text: The D237062 review corrects the content-container assertion message that had incorrectly said title bar, and fixes the close-button image diagnostic typo. The fixed structure test counts .content and says Contains 1 content container; that is diagnostic accuracy, separate from whether a message includes should. Current separate open/close tests await show and check button/Escape closure, while child counts alone do not prove focus, modal behavior or accessible names. Existing351ec7b59de9a58498e272510a84bb43222d6817c1166543b2c2d0e0a2843c02 owns those close paths. This scoped historical example adds no exemption to the deliberate should-message writing instruction and no missing-should-only review defect. No tests ran.
title: Calendar dialog structure assertions name the element they count
